text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":16,"why":"Patient described wheezing starting two days ago after cleaning a dusty environment."},{"i":1,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":35,"why":"Patient explicitly stated no chest pain."},{"i":2,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":41,"why":"Patient reported drinking 4-5 glasses of water daily."},{"i":3,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":44,"why":"Patient mentioned a history of asthma as a child and hay fever in the summer."},{"i":4,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":59,"why":"Patient denied being allergic to anything and had no regular medications."},{"i":5,"v":"INFERRED","u":75,"why":"Given the patient's history of asthma and hay fever, the doctor inferred the differential diagnoses."},{"i":6,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":83,"why":"Doctor advised the patient to take an antihistamine and to visit a clinic for further tests."}]}
